label: Builds new pools
true_when: builds or installs new swimming pools

label: Inground pools
true_when: builds or works on inground pools, stated in words

label: Gunite or concrete
faq: Which {plural} in {city} build gunite or concrete pools?
true_when: builds gunite, shotcrete or concrete pools

label: Vinyl liner
faq: Who installs or replaces vinyl liner pools in {city}?
true_when: builds vinyl liner pools or replaces liners

label: Spa or hot tub
faq: Which {plural} in {city} add a spa or hot tub?
true_when: builds, installs or sells spas or hot tubs (a company name with Spa in it is not enough)

label: Remodels and resurfacing
faq: Who remodels or resurfaces existing pools in {city}?
true_when: remodels, renovates or resurfaces existing pools

label: Screen enclosures
true_when: builds or repairs screen enclosures, pool cages or lanais

label: Pavers and decking
faq: Which {plural} in {city} install pavers or pool decks?

label: States a contractor license
faq: Which {plural} in {city} state a contractor license on their website?
true_when: states a contractor license on its site (a number, or words such as certified pool contractor, licensed and insured)

label: Warranty
true_when: mentions a warranty on its own work or products
